definition: Restrictions that prevent someone from acting freely or independently.
author: Matthew Gregory Lewis
quote: He thought upon Matilda’s beauty and affection; Upon the pleasures which He might have shared with her, had He not been restrained by monastic fetters.
example_sentence: Leaving the job felt like throwing off her fetters.
